note:
Park Valley read off the enumerator's page for 1891, transcribed by A. Hagues and checked line by line before import. Fifteen households, eighty-four people, of whom eleven were already in the record.

**Two households in the record are one or two people short.** Ernest Jardine's at 19 Park Valley holds five of its six and wants only Edna W Jardine, his daughter, two months old at the census and so easily passed over. Rachael P Hutchinson's household wants its head and a housemaid; the record has the niece and the cook but not the woman whose house it was.

**Two houses the enumerator walked have no property in the record.** There is no 13 Park Valley among the properties, though the schedule for it is plain enough and gives Walter Wadsworth and five others. And Sunny Side, the largest household on the street at fifteen people under John Howard Bradwell, has no property either. Both are left unfiled with the address written out.

**Schedule 125 is not on this street at all.** The enumerator headed it Lenton Road, and it is filed here under that street rather than forced into Park Valley, even though it sits at the head of his Park Valley run.

Four further households carry no house number on the page and are likewise unfiled. Everything with a number files to the property the record already keeps for it.
source: 1891 census enumerator's page for Park Valley and Lenton Road, Nottingham, transcribed by A. Hagues.
